description.value:
Duration constant

The distance at which every advantage anyone has over you stops applying.

Adjacent creatures do not benefit from concealment, cover, or any circumstance bonus to AC against your ranged Strikes, and your critical hits against adjacent creatures deal an additional die of damage. Creatures larger than you gain no bonus from their size against these Strikes.

cinderfall.incomplete: overall — on the cover/concealment-suppression clause, no selector found for suppressing a creature's size-based AC bonus specifically. The extra-crit-damage-die-vs-adjacent clause alone would likely be REAL via DamageDice with a predicate (similar shape to Gunslinger's Blast Tackle, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-14/blast-tackle.json, "key": "DamageDice"), but two of the card's three clauses are unbuildable, so this is not proposed as MIXED — flagged in Open Questions as a partial-REAL candidate for a future narrower pass. "Ignore/downgrade cover" clauses have no confirmed rule element: the full rule-element/ directory listing contains nothing named for cover. This is flagged rather than asserted as a confirmed absence, since the actual cover-to-AC/Reflex calculation code path itself wasn't traced independently.
